name: dotme
description: Dotfiles for your AI agents: your preferences in a private GitHub repo, served to every agent over MCP.

OWNER_PASSPHRASE.description: A long passphrase (12 characters or more) for signing in to your dotme. Keep it in a password manager.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: A fine-grained GitHub token with **Contents: Read and write** on your private data repo only. [Create one](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new?name=dotme&description=dotme+server%3A+read+and+write+the+data+repo&expires_in=366&contents=write), choose **Only select repositories** and pick the data repo.

GITHUB_REPO.description: Your private data repo as `owner/name`, for example `octocat/dotme-data`. Create it first: see [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/AFFFPupu/dotme/blob/main/INSTALL.md#deploy-to-cloudflare).

OAUTH_KV.description: Sign-in state: OAuth grants, sessions and passkeys. Leave the default to create a new namespace.
